message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Daily sweep for the Products.txt list, covering the 24-hour window ending 2026-07-14 05:10 IST (2026-07-13 23:40 UTC). No credible, newly reported vulnerability was found that clearly maps to the monitored products during this window.

**Findings**

No relevant new vulnerabilities were confirmed in the last 24 hours. Fresh public items reviewed during the sweep were either outside the monitored product list, outside the 24-hour window based on primary-source dates, or not specific enough to map safely to a listed product.

**Possible matches needing review**

**Cisco IOS / CVE-2008-4128**

- Severity: Medium / CVSS 4.3 as reported by secondary CVE trackers; CISA KEV confirms active exploitation but does not use the monitored product names.
- Description: CISA added a legacy Cisco IOS 12.4 cross-site request forgery issue to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-07-13. Public reporting describes the affected target as Cisco IOS 12.4 on Cisco 871 Integrated Services Routers.
- Why this is only a possible match: The monitored list names Cisco Nexus, Cisco UCS, and Cisco Fabric Extender. Those are not the same as Cisco IOS 12.4 on Cisco 871 routers, so I did not include this as a confirmed finding. Review only if the environment also contains legacy Cisco IOS routers.
- Sources: CISA KEV catalog (https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog?field_cve=CVE-2008-4128); NVD/search-confirmed CVE record and current reporting including Security Affairs and TheHackerWire.

**Sources checked**

High-signal sources included CISA KEV/search results, NVD/CVE search results, Cisco Security Advisories, Fortinet PSIRT, SonicWall PSIRT, Google Chrome Releases, Mozilla Security Advisories, Microsoft Security Update Guide, Ubuntu Security Notices, OpenSSL security advisories, Apache Tomcat security pages, Grafana security advisories, Ubiquiti/UniFi security advisory reporting, Wordfence entries for WordPress/Yoast SEO/Advanced Custom Fields, Adobe Security Bulletins, and credible secondary security reporting when it pointed back to primary advisories. MongoDB-related searches included MongoDB server, Ops Manager, Atlas, drivers, connectors, and adjacent official components.

Closing note: No immediate vulnerability-review action is recommended from confirmed findings in this run. The Cisco IOS KEV item should be checked only if legacy Cisco IOS routers are present alongside the monitored Cisco Nexus/UCS/Fabric Extender estate.
